<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the base peak at m/z 235.1395 corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 234.13 Da. The relative intensity of the M+1 peak (~16 %) indicates roughly 15 carbon atoms. A formula that fits this mass and the isotopic pattern is C₁₅H₂₄NO (C₁₅H₂₄O₁N₁).</thought>
<final_answer>C15H24NO</final_answer>
